edits.text: PARTIES. This Executive Employment Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. (the “Company”) and [Executive’s full legal name] (the “Executive”), effective as of [effective date].

2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of [amount and currency to be agreed] (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding, plus [benefits to be agreed].

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause [definition to be agreed], the Executive shall receive [severance amount or formula, payment timing, and conditions to be agreed].

Open for discussion; not agreed. Please confirm governing law and the Executive’s work location before settling this provision. Any restrictive covenant requires review for legality, enforceability, and appropriate scope, including restricted activities, geography, duration, and any required consideration.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered agreement and cover note contain no confidential Seller minimum price or indication of hidden content requiring removal. The economic terms remain placeholders, not concessions.

receiver.message_back: The Executive’s identity, effective date, compensation, work location and governing jurisdiction remain subject to client confirmation; we propose severance covering termination without narrowly defined Cause or resignation for Good Reason, with accrued compensation payable independently of any release. We propose deleting the blanket non-compete; any alternative must be lawful in the applicable jurisdiction, narrowly tailored to demonstrable business interests and supported by separate consideration, with all terms subject to client approval.

drafter.private_reasoning: The outstanding employment terms require client confirmation. The edits provide a proposed severance framework and delete the blanket non-compete without treating either point as agreed. Unrelated confidential pricing information is not included.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We propose the attached revisions, subject to client approval. They extend the proposed severance framework to termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason, preserve accrued compensation independently of a release, and delete the blanket non-compete. The definitions and severance economics remain open, as do the Executive’s identity, effective date, compensation, work location and governing law. Any alternative restrictive covenant would require separate agreement following jurisdiction-specific review and separate consideration.

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Executive shall receive [severance amount or formula, payment timing, and conditions to be agreed]. “Cause” shall be narrowly defined by mutual agreement. The definition of “Good Reason,” including applicable notice and cure procedures, remains subject to agreement. Any release requirement shall apply only to severance and shall not condition payment of earned but unpaid compensation, reimbursable business expenses, or other accrued entitlements payable under applicable law or the governing benefit plans. All definitions, amounts, timing and conditions remain subject to client approval.

4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. The proposed twelve-month post-employment non-compete is deleted. Any alternative restrictive covenant requires separate written agreement and client approval, must be lawful in the applicable jurisdiction and narrowly tailored to demonstrable business interests, and must be supported by separate consideration. No post-employment non-compete is imposed by this Section.
Please confirm the Executive’s full legal name, effective date, principal work location and proposed governing jurisdiction. All remain open and subject to client approval.
Base Salary, currency and benefits remain to be agreed and subject to client approval.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered agreement and cover note do not disclose the client's confidential minimum sale price or otherwise reference it. No hidden-content categories are identified as containing confidential information.

receiver.message_back: Subject to our client’s approval, we propose three months’ Base Salary continuation for termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason, conditioned on an effective release covering severance only; Cause should include fraud, serious misconduct, material breach and persistent failure to perform duties, with cure rights where appropriate, and Good Reason should require a material reduction in salary or duties, prompt written notice and a 30-day cure period. We accept deletion of the non-compete and independent payment of accrued entitlements, but reserve lawful confidentiality and trade-secret protections; no agreement is binding until the remaining terms, including identity, compensation, work location and governing law, are settled and the agreement is executed.
